matched_section: ## Label reliability and model accuracy (matched design)

Sets S1, S2, S4, S5, S6 (S3 has too few raters). In both groups the target of a held-out set is the consensus of 3 randomly drawn raters and the training labels are the consensus of k other raters per training set; the target persons are never used for training. Ridge on SigLIP2-base features, leave-one-set-out; means of 500 rater draws.
On these sets: rho 0.565 / 0.154, required-rater ratio VN/JP 7.1; rho_spec 0.268 / 0.067.
| Group | k | Label reliability (Spearman-Brown) | Label reliability (empirical) | Model accuracy (corrected) | Rank correlation (uncorrected) |
Correlation between sqrt(label reliability) and model accuracy over the 8 conditions: 0.995. Accuracy / sqrt(label reliability): JP 0.83, 0.81, 0.80, 0.79; VN 0.60, 0.68, 0.74, 0.78.
Element-specific part, k = 4, rank correlation (uncorrected): JP 0.473, VN 0.158 (reliability of the 3-rater target 0.55 / 0.18).
Uncertainty: interval from 400 resamples of the images within sets with new rater draws; p from 600 exchanges of group labels between raters (two-sided, not Holm-adjusted).
